title: Cyclic reflections and the flip equation for the graded Grothendieck-Teichmüller group
summary: Furusho, Hirose and Komiyama reformulated the pentagon equation using an involution called the flip, which led to a new characterisation of the graded Grothendieck-Teichmüller group $\mathsf{GRT}_1$. We show that the flip is a reflection in the cyclic structure of the operad of framed Drinfeld-Kohno Lie algebras, with the framings removed. Applying the reflection twice to the pentagon gives the two-cycle relation for every Drinfeld associator.
